Why did tens of thousands of migrants from Morocco suddenly cross into Europe through the Spanish enclave of Ceuta in just a few days? According to Spanish authorities, about 48,000 of the roughly 50,000 people who crossed into Ceuta by land and sea returned to Morocco within 48 hours. At least 72 people died during the crossings. The late July mass crossing has raised questions about migration, politics and border security. We take a closer look at what may have triggered it. #ceuta #morocco
